messages.text: Before I submit the dental form, what should I put for the place that asks for current payroll info?
Leave that part blank for now. The last one was the espresso place, but I haven't had a check from them this month.
Okay. Please also send the two applications you mentioned before dinner so you do not keep pushing them later.
Doing tasting room events first, then the posting with the Reels/caption samples.
I left the clinic bill folder on the counter. Also, the SLO venue assistant posting says medical starts after 60 days and shifts are posted two weeks ahead.
That one caught my eye. I can picture the guest side, but the packet asks for sample deposit tracking and COI stuff.
Did you send the thank-you note to the tasting room person?
Yeah. I kept it short and asked if there was anything I should tighten before the next one.
Print it and mark the parts you do not understand. You are good in the room; now show them you can keep the folder clean too.
I will. Going to make a checklist before I start making the cover letter sound too shiny.
Good. Add the dinner photos and the guest-list sample to the folder before you forget.
Doing that now. Splitting it into setup, front table, people shots, and captions.
Wind drops after 5. Avila nets or are you doing the living-room mat thing again?
Avila. I already did the mat stuff Monday, so sand sounds less boring.
Paso Vine sent the short no-thanks email. I keep rereading it like a genius.
Good. Bring the blue ball. Sofia said two more might come.
Stop feeding the inbox. Shoes, water, Meadow Park nets at 6:20.
That is not subtle.
Correct. You can stare at one email after you shank three serves.
Leaving Paso at 5:20 if 101 isn't dumb.
Court at Pismo is open at 6 if you can make it before rehearsal.
I can do one fast set, then head straight to SLO Center. Save me the least sandy side.
Deal. Also Leo says the taco truck is by the theater after, so don't disappear.
Fine, but only because Leo still owes me for the last scene game.
Are you coming to the SLO Community Center mixer Thursday? The event crew from Higuera is supposed to be there.
Probably. Need to run my blue shirt through the wash first. It survived volleyball but barely.
Blue shirt, black jeans, clean shoes. Done. Please do not show up in the hoodie with the frayed cuff lol.
Putting taco money toward laundromat quarters. Very glamorous.
Found a $218 round fare out of SLO for late April 👀
Tempting, but my separate account is sitting at 940 after car stuff.
Ugh. Put it in the dream pile then?
Yeah. I set the little Friday move again once my check hits.
If you are coming by the west block later, bring the small shovel. Drip line is clogged again.
Yeah. I wanted to look at the creek crossing too. Last time by Cerro Alto it was basically a stripe of rocks.
That is why every gallon matters out here. Vines, houses, trails, all the same bucket.
I know. Hard to talk about Paso without talking about water.
They blocked 12th St by the park. Looks like booths and a little stage going up.
Worth walking over after dinner? If there are carts near the plaza I can grab something for everyone.
Ask your mom. I just know parking will be a mess.
Messy parking is fine if Emily comes too. Those nights are better when nobody bails early.
Can you take me after 3? Mom said she is stuck doing the 2:30 reminder calls and Dad took the truck up by the barrel room.
Yeah. Text me when the bell rings.
Also Mom left the insurance folder on the kitchen table again. Don't let Dad put muddy boots near it lol
I'll move it before he gets home from the pump thing.
Someone in my class posted a scary screenshot about the spring clinic thing. Mom says not to bring it up at dinner lol.
Can you move your laundry from the hallway before Mom gets home? Also your old desk is blocking the printer again.
Send me the screenshot. If it is just a cropped post with no link, I am not passing it around.
Yeah. The room feels like a storage unit with a bed now.
Sent. It has like 9 crying emojis and no source, classic.
It is literally your freshman-year cave with better shoes.
I found the county page and Dr. Nguyen's office has the same basic note. The screenshot is leaving out half the sentence.
Trying to make it temporary. Need paychecks that don't disappear into gas and car insurance first.
Mom said you're doing dinner. pls tell me it's not mystery green soup
For my civics slide, do you remember that SLO thing you went to with Mateo? Was it loud or chill?
No soup. Salmon, tomatoes with mozzarella, and the basil I brought home from the beds.
Chill. People had signs, a few speakers, and we mostly stood near the back and listened.
ok acceptable. can you save me extra tomatoes before Dad destroys them
Ok. Also can I mention the town hall ideas you said, like cameras on uniforms and making complaints easier to look up?
Yeah, those are concrete enough. Add training that is more than one afternoon too.
Already set some aside. I still have to rinse the soil off the basil first.
Did you finish the online forms before dinner? They always ask the same long list.
Yeah. Mostly clicked no and left the regular-meds box blank. Took longer to remember my insurance login.
Good. If the job stuff starts eating your sleep again, promise me you will book a proper appointment instead of only talking in the kitchen.
Promise. Not there right now, but I would if it got that big.
If you stop by Smart & Final, can you get chicken, rice, and the coffee Dad likes? Keep the receipt, please.
Yeah. I can cover the chicken and coffee today, but maybe not the whole cart.
That is fine. I already scheduled the bigger house payments for Monday, so just text me what you spend.
Got it. I'll send a pic from checkout.
Still in for tomorrow or are you letting the ridge people guilt-trip me alone?
In. I packed gloves after dinner. I need the climb more than my email inbox needs another refresh.
Good. Same carpool spot at 6:50. You can stare at rocks dramatically after we clear brush.
Deal. Brush first, dramatic rock staring after.
Can you bring the tiny speaker Tuesday? The warmup playlist on my phone is cursed.
Yeah. Same Room B at the center?
Yep, 6:45. Also Marco wants us early because the two-person scene thing kept eating time.
I can get there by 6:35 if traffic out of Paso behaves.
Can you help me clear the back corner after breakfast? Green bin is almost empty.
Yeah. I need to move my laundry first because Emily dumped a poster board on the hallway floor.
Figures. Your mom wants the Costco run done before lunch too.
I’ll do both. Save me the small rake this time.
Can you grab me after photo club at 4? Also taco truck is outside school 👀
Ride yes. Taco truck no for me, I packed the leftover pasta like a responsible boring person.
Tragic. Are you also still wearing the same black jeans to everything
Until April at least. The jeans are fine and my card total is behaving.
Mom said your blue folder is on the printer. Why do you have like 6 county copies in there
Because every job form wants a slightly different thing. The SLO County one, the card from when I turned 18, the whole boring stack.
Also the school survey popped up again. Do I check the same boring boxes as you and Mom?
Ask Mom, but yeah for us it is usually the no on the origin question and the first ancestry/race box after that.
why are you still in the kitchen scrolling those winery pages
I was going to send one follow-up and somehow ended up on three people’s new-job posts
close it and eat the leftover rice before mom sees the mug situation
rude but fair. putting the mug in the sink and saving the tabs for breakfast.
I found the Paso High envelope in the file box. Do you still need the final transcript scan for your Cuesta login?
Maybe. The portal shows my units, but the scan might help if an application asks for dates.
I put it on the kitchen counter. Also, compare the fee pages before you click anything.
Yeah, that is why I am checking old records first.
Sent you the reel from SLO Nights. Food trucks plus live music by the creek on Friday.
You still coming to Bishop Peak at 2 or did your little colored boxes betray us?
Saw it in their Story too. I saved the post before it disappeared.
Still coming. I moved the volunteer email to 12:40 and gave myself 20 min for the Chamber LinkedIn message.
Excellent. Put water in one of those boxes too please.
Perfect. Also your serve from yesterday is in my camera roll and it is rude how good it looked.
Send it. My For You page keeps throwing me jump-serve clips and now I need proof I am improving.
Already did. If the hike stays on the day doesn't turn into me staring at the same three apps.
If you come by the crush pad, wear shoes you can hose off.
Got it. I wanted a couple pictures that aren't just patio glasses and sunset rows.
Good. Ask before you shoot the crew. They start stacking bins at 10.
I'll keep it quick. Also bringing the extra hand truck after the garden pickup.
The FreeFile screen says both returns were accepted. Did you save the PDFs in your folder?
The county envelope is still on the kitchen counter. Do you want me to leave it by your keys?
Yeah, saved them. It shows +42 federal and +16 state once the bank clears it.
Yeah, please. I want to compare the rental cap thing with the water district notes before I seal it.
Good. Put that in savings, please. If the tire place is anywhere near $400, talk to me or Dad before leaving it sitting on the Visa.
I can handle it from savings if it lands there. I just won't do food trucks after volleyball for a bit.
I put it next to the blue pen. Remember the back flap needs your signature.
Thanks. Also sending you that 5-minute clip about the hotel fee item, because Dad asked what I was muttering about.
Beach set at noon? Wind looks chill and we need a fourth.
I'm in. Doing a slow stretch first because yesterday's hike made my legs wooden.
Bring the little cold pack again lol. Last time everyone copied you.
Already tossed it in. Also bringing the wrap, mostly so Mateo stops side-eyeing my footwork.
Can you help me caption the Cabo throwback or are you going to give me your 9th grade workbook phrases again
I can offer 'donde esta la playa' and vibes. That trip did not make me useful.
tragic. send the airport pic anyway, the tan line one is funny
Only if you crop out me holding the little phrase card like a lost freshman.
The food truck carousel looks GOOD. Third slide is the one, the salsa cup color pops.
I almost used the first one but the steam looked weird after I warmed it up. Swapped the order.
Also your Story link got more replies than the flyer post lol. Did the restaurant account see it?
Yeah, two profile taps from it and one save already. I might pin that set if it keeps moving.
Found a SLO event page: Basque bites, olive oil guy, two small pours, and the host is doing a behind-the-counter Q&A.
That sounds exactly like the kind of thing worth leaving the house for. I care more about the Q&A than the pours tbh.
Sure, Mr. Notebook. You can ask 900 questions and then nurse one glass like you're paying rent on it.
One with the food is plenty. Send me the link?
Dinner is in the fridge. You came back from SLO looking less wound up, so I assume Mateo made you run around.
Two games, one lecture about sending follow-up emails, and a taco stop.
Good. Listen to the person who gets you moving instead of pacing by the kitchen counter.
He also said my cover letter sounded like a brochure for soup, so there's that.
If you talk to Halter Ranch, ask who handles parking signs and guest line at release nights.
Good call. I was going to ask about front gate timing and where they want photo stuff turned in.
Also have a clean link ready. Nobody wants to dig through 200 sunset pictures.
I made a shorter link last night. Just the useful ones plus two caption examples.
Need the driveway clear by 5. You taking the truck again?
Just for the bins and the extra compost bags after my Vine St. shift. Back before 4:30.
Fine. Put a towel down this time.
Will do. If the chard looks good, I'll use it with pasta tonight instead of buying more.
Can you help with the side yard Friday morning, or do you have a shift?
I can help. Nothing scheduled for pay this week.
The winery crew spent half the morning chasing one missing food truck certificate. That is the part guests never see.
Exactly the stuff I need reps on. I can keep people calm when the speaker dies, but one missing form can sink the day.
Good. Bring gloves. Also, the events manager at Meridian said they actually read short follow-up emails.
I'll send one after we finish. I reused the rush-line and closing-cleanup bullets like you said.
Make a binder: vendor contacts, deposit dates, city permit, backup numbers. Same as tools in the truck.
I am adding that tonight. Also checking whether the SLO place has set days or if it is another surprise-text-at-9pm situation.
Can you pick me up after photo club at 5:10 or are you doing your beach athlete thing
I have volleyball 3:30-4:45, then pickup is in there for 5:10. Bring the SD card.
Can you drive me after school? Also mom said your form printer jammed lol
Yes for the ride. Printer survived. My pages were boring anyway: no daily pills, no weekly appointment thing, no special instructions.
lol "in there" like the rectangle decides your life
Boring is fine. More time for you to be my unpaid chauffeur.
The rectangle also has apply to SLO Brew events at 9:20, so yes it is currently winning.
Amazing career path. If the boring part ever changes, you can roast me in the waiting room.
Can u drive me to school thing at 6? mom said ask you
Yes. Also remind me to open the money screen after dinner.
the one with your dramatic red line?
Can you take me to rehearsal at 6? Mom has the late desk shift and Dad said his truck is staying at the shop.
Fine, but I’m choosing music. Also move your photo stuff off the kitchen table before I start dinner.
Exactly. It was 987 this morning, so no random Paso-to-SF idea yet.
You still have sophomore year volleyball trophies in your room. Do not lecture me on clutter.
Those are historic artifacts. Be ready at 5:45.
You left the kitchen speaker connected again
My bad. Was replaying that Brandi clip from Stories while fixing the photo crop.
I knew it was you because Dad does not play dramatic guitar lady while washing pans
Rude but accurate. Send the final edit before we leave for the park thing Saturday.
I paid PG&E and the Costco order this morning. You do not need to add those to your sheet.
Got it. Mine is at $284 so far, so I skipped the coffee line after dropping Emily.
Good. There is coffee at home, and dinner is already planned.
Perfect. I also left the SLO Vintage cart alone even though that green overshirt keeps following me around.
You sent the follow-up yet or are you ironing the same sleeve for 40 minutes
Sent it. Also the sleeve needed help. The Paso wine walk thing has too many people who remember faces.
Fair. Wear the non-sad shoes. Nobody needs the beach volleyball edition.
I found polish in the garage. Zero dollar upgrade.
You doing Avila tonight or did the theater people steal you again?
Avila first. Then Sofia's sending me to some downtown Paso music thing if my legs still work.
Classic. Pack a real shirt, not the sand hoodie.
Rude but accurate. Want me to grab you anything if I end up by the food tents?
Volleyball after your SLO center thing or are you doing the dramatic hand waving all night?
Ends around 8:30. Depends if they make us redo the grocery-store bit again.
That bit better be worth missing serves.
It was weirdly funny last time. I'll text when I'm out.
Sunny icon all afternoon 😎 Thursday sand?
Yes. I can do Morro or Avila, but Morro gets cold fast.
Avila then. 6:15? I want one clean set before improv fries my brain.
6:15 works. My shoulders survived Tuesday, somehow.
Food truck night in downtown Paso Friday?? I can send you the post.
Maybe. I told Mom I'd grab pantry stuff first if my paycheck hits tomorrow.
Responsible James appears. Screenshotting this for evidence 😂
Don't get dramatic. I just live close enough to be useful when the kitchen list gets long.
Leaving for the yard run at 7:15. You eat yet?
Not yet. I was rewriting the same application paragraph again.
Toast first. One paragraph after. Don’t start with coffee and six tabs.
Got it. Toast is in. Tabs closed except the actual posting.
Your mom wants to know if you saw Aunt Linda's Facebook note about Sunday lunch.
Yeah, I opened it earlier. Nana commented twice before I even replied.
Bring the folding chairs from the garage. Your grandpa asked for the good ones.
Got it. I'll load them after Emily's ride.
Shop called. Tire and alignment estimate is $397 if they don't find anything else.
Okay. I can move it from savings tonight. That's going to sting though.
Better than letting the card sit. If savings gets too thin, ask before you do that.
Yeah. I'm pausing SLO dinners and random stuff until the next paycheck.
That clip you sent was the same room where they argued about vineyard wells last year.
I recognized the dais from YouTube, not from actually sitting there. The basin comments were less boring at 1.5x speed.
Figures. Did the form ask you to pick a side again?
I left that line empty like usual. Still checking who has a real plan for housing and creek runoff.
Can you help me pick pics for my ag class board? Need one "local place" photo and mine are boring.
Use the dry creek one from Santa Margarita with the vineyard row behind it. It says more than another sunset.
That one is kinda sad lol
Yeah, but it is honest. Food, hills, and water are basically the whole story here.
Can u make my yearbook hallway pic less yellow before I submit it
Send the original, not the screenshot. I can pull the lights down and straighten it after dinner.
Can u drive me after practice? also your Cuesta parking sticker is still on the desk lol
Yeah, I can get you at 6:10. And wow, ancient artifact.
Fine bossy. Also mom saw your hike grid thing and asked why all the rocks look dramatic now.
Mom said don't toss it because it has some number you need?
Because the flat version looked like homework. I kept the darker one since people actually stopped on it.
Probably my ID. I need it for the record request, not for anything this month.
Group chat is turning that county post into a whole soap opera. You commenting or staying boring?
Staying boring. I am reading the actual PDF, not a stitched-together reel with siren sounds.
Wow, growth. Please also apply that energy to job emails.
The PDF says the opposite of the reel caption. I am just dropping the link and leaving before the clapback parade starts.
Sent you the 3BR on Higuera. Stop staring at it like Zillow is going to hire you.
If I had one normal schedule and another person for the third room, the math is less ugly.
Then send the follow-ups tomorrow. Also your car trunk cannot be your filing cabinet forever.
Rude but accurate. Mom already asked why my pay stubs are next to the cereal.
If you go by that open house today, watch how they move people from patio to barrel room. That part matters.
Yeah, that's what I want to see. The pretty part is easy; I want the traffic flow and how they explain the local stuff.
Good. Eat first if they are pouring. Don't make it your lunch.
Already packed a sandwich. I am there for notes, not to wobble around Tin City.
Can u look at my photo captions before 5? The teacher said mine sound like a menu lol
Send them. I'm at the tables by the seed swap but I can edit between people.
You are physically unable to just attend something.
Someone had to make the sign for the quince jam lady and keep the compost buckets from blocking the walkway.
For the renewal form, use the Paso Robles house for current address. The old school forms in the cabinet only show Creston Road and the SLO apartment.
Okay. They ask for previous addresses, so I was checking if I was missing anything from when I was little.
No, nothing else. I put the certificate copy and the Mexico trip receipt in the blue folder.
You alive, old man? 21 laps around the sun and still in Paso.
Barely. Mom already made pancakes and reminded me I showed up in SLO at exactly the most inconvenient time.
Classic. Bring the ID tonight if that downtown place gets dramatic.
Yeah. And I still need to finish that background packet before we go, including the not-applicable parts.
When you get home, grab the mail from the box. Your mom is waiting on that renewal packet for the front desk system.
Got it. Are you still out by the lower road?
Yes. Irrigation timer is acting up and the lift battery needs charging before Monday.
I'll put Mom's packet on her side of the counter and leave your charger by the garage door.
Grandma asked if you are coming to Easter brunch. I told her yes for food unless you say otherwise.
Yes to brunch and helping with chairs. I will probably skip the morning part again.
That is fine. Please still be home by noon so we can go together.
Noon works. I might walk the river path before we leave so I am less twitchy at the long table.
Please put the reusable ice sleeve back in the freezer when you are done with it.
Done after ten more minutes. I drank the giant bottle too, so you can stop giving it the look.
Good. And take something only if you still need it later, not just because Mateo says everyone should carry a pharmacy.
I'm fine. Just normal after sand games, and the brace didn't bug me at all.
That forum was very you. Took notes like a nerd, said one sentence, vanished.
One good sentence. The co-responder van thing deserved airtime.
Fair. Also your highway story was tame. Mine has more drama and I was not even driving.
A warning for speed is all I have. Your friend-of-a-friend night is why we always pick a DD before bars.
Saw you parked out front. Bad call from that event coordinator?
They filled it internally. I told Mateo and he just sent a pin for Pismo courts.
Sounds about right. Go. Yard stuff can wait until Saturday morning.
Appreciate it. He already said I get one complaint per side change.
Can you pick me up after photo club at 4:20 or are you doing the counter thing again?
I can pick you up. Counter thing ended already, remember?
Oh right. Mom said you're making sample posts for that downtown place?
Yeah, two captions and a weekend event blurb. Then I'm sending the winery one tonight.
You done hiding in folder-land or still renaming JPGs like a finance guy?
Almost done. The first version was chaos, so now it's only check-in, guest flow, best people shots, and post samples.
Good. Send the follow-up before volleyball. No 11:59 pm dramatic artist nonsense.
Sending by 5. Also saving the picnic route idea in case I can build it into something later.
Dr. Nguyen's office posted the updated March note in the portal. I can print it at work if you want it for Grandma.
Yes please. She keeps getting auntie's forwarded videos, and the portal note is easier than arguing.
I will bring it home after my shift. Also check the county FAQ; our front desk has been pointing people there.
Thanks. I will send Grandma those two links and nothing from the comment threads.
I left the lint roller by the coffee maker. Your gray pants are hanging on the laundry-room door.
Thank you. I moved $25 from gas money for the cleaner, so I am trying not to wrinkle them before noon.
Take the spare hanger in the car. Also eat something before you go downtown.
Will do. The vineyard office thing is at 11:30, then the plaza vendor night after.
I put your W-2 copy and the bank statement on the counter. Please do not leave them in your room with the camera batteries.
Got it. I am making a folder before work.
Good. The savings transfer cleared, so update your rent worksheet before you look at more listings.
Already did. The 2BR numbers still need another steady check coming in.
When you fill out the clinic portal, use the same answers from your old Cuesta paperwork. First origin question was no, then the box we always use for our side of the family.
Found it. The SLO County birth copy is still in the folder too.
Good. For the employment section, if it asks for prior federal uniform paperwork, leave it blank unless they require N/A.
Got it. I only uploaded the card from 2023 and the regular ID stuff.
You still pretending you're not looking at Yosemite cabins?
Looking is free. Booking is the part that gets me yelled at by my own phone.
Adult calendar strikes again.
It moved 75 this morning, so I'm close. If it stays above 1000 after gas, then we can talk.
Did you send the follow-up or are you charming the draft document again
Sent. Attached the little mock run sheet and the budget tab, even though the permit questions made me sweat.
Look at you, using calendars like a taxpaying adult. What did they say about time off?
Accrual after 90 days, shifts locked a week ahead unless there is a private buyout. Better than the chaos board.
Trail crew moved Bishop Peak to Sunday. Still in?
Yeah. I did Thursday sand, so Saturday can be the lazy day.
Lazy day for you means pushups and pretending it doesn't count.
Only if my calves stop yelling by tomorrow.
Beach tomorrow or are you booked doing Lee HQ chores again?
Morning is out. Dad needs help with the side gate, Mom put me on grocery duty, and Emily has a ride thing.
So noon. Also your old Paso room better not still have that blue wall.
It does. Same dent from when Em threw a hairbrush at me too.
Need the truck at 10:30 or can you take Emily first?
I can take her. Nothing on my calendar except the grocery run and volleyball later.
Your mom said the follow-up from your check-in was clean. Keep moving, eat real food, sleep before midnight.
That's the plan. If my head starts making the schedule instead of me, I'll set up something official.
Can u check if this menu line says chicken or cheese before I put it in my photo project
Send it, but my confidence is basically Senora Martinez plus ordering tacos in Puerto Vallarta.
so... Google it is
Rude but accurate. I recognize pollo. After that I become decorative.
Beach courts at 2. Stop scrolling SLO pages and actually show up.
Bishop Peak at 10 or are you still pretending 86 in March is normal?
I was checking if the farmers market thing got moved because of wind.
Starting earlier. I want shade before the switchbacks turn into a pan.
Sure. And the recipe videos were weather research too?
Bring extra water. Also your river cleanup post got my coworker asking where to volunteer, so congrats nerd.
One pasta clip. Maybe two. I'll be there at 2.
Good. If people like the grapes and beaches, they can help with the creek beds too.
You done playing dirt monk or are we hiking at noon
Almost done. Had to stake the pea rows and grab carrots before the stand closed.
Naturally. Your backpack smells like salad half the time.
Worth it. Carrot tops are going into risotto later if they survive the hike.
Paso page posted the Saturday lineup. Same tamale cart as last time plus that little bluegrass trio.
Send it. I want to get there before the first set, not wander in halfway like Mateo.
Also your queen B.C. reposted tour rehearsal clips. I saw your instant reaction lol
Caught me. Saturday is better if we make a whole night of it after volleyball.
Improv at 7:30 still? I saw you liked like five event-coordinator posts in a row lol
Yeah still coming. I fell into the announcement rabbit hole after that coordinator listing went quiet.
Bring yourself, not the tabs. Also eat something, you get weird when dinner is just iced coffee.
Sandwich acquired. Phone going face down until after class.
Your aunt asked what you meant at dinner about public complaint summaries. I told her you follow the local meeting notes, but you can explain it better.
I just think people should not need a lawyer brain to see patterns. Same with cameras actually being turned on and footage kept.
That is reasonable. Please keep Sunday dinner calm; Grandma still brings up the SLO march every time.
I know. I told her it was one afternoon, peaceful, and I mostly listened.
Please remind Dad that his recert card is in the glove box. He said the safety binder is checked tomorrow morning.
I will. Do you need anything from town?
Just highlighters. We are short at check-in, and I have to fix three schedule templates before 8.
I'll get them after dropping Emily off.
Your Story from yesterday was weirdly calm?? everyone else posted mud and you posted fog on a fence lol
That fence fog did more for me than the whole week of job tabs.
Fair. Also I liked that you stayed for tacos after instead of disappearing into your quiet-mountain-man era.
Tacos counted too. Dirt first, people after, somehow both helped.
Are you eating before you drive to San Luis tonight, or should I save you dinner?
Save a little? I have the center group until 8:30, then Sofia and I might grab tacos.
Okay. Please take the jacket from the laundry room if you will be out late.
Got it. Also I printed the prompt list this time, so I won't forget it on the counter.
If you want the barrel room before staff starts moving cases, be there by 7:40 Saturday.
That works. I want the empty room, the setup table, and maybe the lights before guests show.
Keep out of the forklift lane. Send me the cleaned-up ones after, not twenty versions.
Deal. I’ll do one warm batch and one normal batch, then post the better set after I see which preview people tap.
I left the Lowe's card on the counter. Need mulch and two sprinkler heads after work.
I can pick them up. Want me to put the groceries on my debit while I'm out?
Groceries if you can. Use the card for yard stuff. Your mom and I have the house transfers set already.
Cool. I'll do groceries first and text if Lowe's is out of the sprinkler heads.
Can you drive me to photo club at 4? Also Mom asked if the IRS/CA money hit yet.
I can drive. And yeah, the 42 and 16 showed up, already moved it out of checking.
So no boba stop? tragic.
Not this week. Tire thing plus paying the card clean means home coffee like a responsible boring person.
Before dinner, bring me those old Cuesta pages. We can sort what is useful and what is junk.
I printed the unit list and the fee breakdown. Still feels weird seeing how many options I bounced between.
Options are fine. Guessing expensive is not fine.
That was basically my logic then, too.
Can I use your Spain pics for my photo layout? The street with the yellow walls and that lunch table one.
Yeah, use the Laguardia alley and the table with the peppers. Please don't use the blurry glass photo.
Lol the one where you're holding it like a museum object?
Exactly. Pick the courtyard or the hill trail instead. They show the place better.
Dinner is at 7:45. Did you leave yourself time for the volunteer form before you go meet Mateo?
Yep, 7:10 volunteer form, 7:25 message Nina from the hotel mixer, 8:30 walk with Mateo.
Good. You do better when the evening has actual places to be.
I know. Empty night plus phone equals nothing useful.
Can you help move the vineyard stakes after lunch? Uneven ground by the back fence.
Yeah. I'll wear the taller shoes and bring water.
Good. If your ankle starts talking, leave the last stack for me.
Before the post office, check the garage bin for the Canada ferry photos. Might be behind the old yard tools.
It won't. I played two sets Wednesday and just iced after.
Found them. Also found three folders of my school stuff from Paso, so Mom's filing system wins again.
Keep the photos, toss the duplicate worksheets. Leave the certificate folder on the kitchen table.
I packed a banana and the egg bites on the top shelf. Please take them before you drive Emily.
Thanks. I’m sending the SLO tasting-room follow-up after I drop her off.

events.title: Trader Joe's + Costco list

events.title: Avila courts with Sofia's group

events.title: Nets with M

events.notes: Bring ball, hoodie, water. Phone stays in the backpack until after.

events.title: SLO Community Center group night
events.notes: Bring water. Ask Sofia about ride back if the last round runs late.

events.title: Call Nana before saving weekend posts
events.notes: Ask about her knee, then check the SLO Happenings post Sofia sent.

events.title: March card check
events.notes: Target range: $500-$700. Flag cafe, drive-thru, tees, and event tickets before tapping. Mom/Dad handle the house tabs.

events.title: Cull + color: Bishop Peak / taco truck / Mission Plaza set

events.title: Kitchen table forms with Mom

events.title: County guide + council clip
events.notes: Check return envelope signature line. Rewatch 8-min segment on basin use and short-term rentals before filling notes.

events.title: Tin City: cellar walk + tapas demo
events.notes: Ask about event staffing setup. Skip second flight; save room for the mushroom pincho place after.

events.title: After deposit clears: checking -> do-not-touch bucket
events.notes: $65 scheduled; wait on coastal weekend until bucket shows four digits again.

events.title: Event ops packet practice

events.title: Applications: event floor + IG samples
events.notes: Update resume bullets: POS, espresso bar, closing mats, restock cups/syrups, rush line. Send Paso tasting room assistant and SLO content coordinator postings.

events.title: Clean photo folder + reply notes
events.notes: Move market night shots into 4 folders: arrival table, crowd flow, detail shots, posts. Draft 3 sample captions. Reply to Willow Creek contact by noon.

events.title: Santa Lucia trail crew
events.location: Reservoir Canyon trailhead, San Luis Obispo, CA
events.notes: Bring gloves, water, extra socks. Leave phone mostly away except photos at the ridge.

events.location: Reservoir Canyon Trailhead, San Luis Obispo, CA
events.notes: Pack water, almonds, spare socks. If legs are still fine, meet Sofia near Pismo nets after lunch.

events.title: North County stand + Vine St. beds
events.location: Paso Robles City Park, then Vine St.
events.notes: Bring tote bags, small trowel, and the green volunteer card. Look for asparagus, tomatoes if any, and eggs.

events.title: Bishop Peak trail + late lunch
events.location: Bishop Peak Trailhead, San Luis Obispo, CA
events.notes: Bring extra water. Text Mateo when leaving Paso. Lunch plan depends on who wants Firestone after.

events.title: Downtown Paso - plaza sets + dinner carts
events.location: Paso Robles Downtown City Park, 12th St side
events.notes: Check Sofia's post for vendor row. Save clip from B.C. page before heading out.

events.title: Salinas River bed cleanup + Templeton farmers market stop
events.notes: Bring gloves, trash bags, hat, 2 water bottles. Check trail photos from last August before posting.

events.title: Budget check: rent split scenarios
events.notes: Run numbers after gas, phone, car insurance, and savings. Compare 2BR vs 3BR listings in SLO/Paso. Keep emergency fund line untouched.

events.title: Check county notice + Dr. Nguyen portal before replying
events.notes: Look at SLO County page first. Compare with CDC update Karen mentioned. Do not repost Mateo's group link until source is clear.

events.notes: Look for plain belt and light button-down under $18. Steam collar before 2:30 coffee near Marsh St.

events.title: Pick up Mom by Dr. Han's building, then meet Dad at gate 3

events.notes: Listen first. Ask about uniform camera storage rules, complaint summary access, and whether county clinicians can be dispatched on certain calls. Bring up traffic-warning story only if it fits.

events.title: Send Mom $45

events.title: Room B run-through
events.notes: Leave Paso by 17:45. Black shirt. Check sign-up sheet near front desk.

events.title: Application lap, then Cerro San Luis trail

events.title: Nana call

events.title: Check paycheck split

events.title: Garage shelves and lunch prep
